notes: Adds a new 'Auto-sync blocked IPs to .htaccess' toggle on Security Settings (off by default) - every 5 minutes, adds any actively-blocked IP (auto-block, manual, Tor) missing from cPanel's .htaccess straight into the file, one read + one write regardless of how many. Catches drift the normal per-IP sync at block time can miss, e.g. a transient cPanel failure or cPanel getting configured after IPs were already blocked. No database update needed for this update.
